# 00. SETUP

```{r setup_libraries}
################################################################################
# 00. SETUP
################################################################################

# Data management
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(jsonlite)

# Statistics
library(osqp)     # simplex-constrained SCM weights
library(fixest)   # DiD cross-check

# Options
options(scipen = 999)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 13))
set.seed(1234)

# Key dates
or_recrim_date   <- as.Date("2024-09-01")
wa_recrim_date   <- as.Date("2023-07-01")
decrim_date      <- as.Date("2021-02-01")
main_pre_from    <- as.Date("2019-01-01")
main_end         <- as.Date("2025-12-01")
fully_post_event <- 11:15

# Estimator: ridge-augmented synthetic control (Ben-Michael, Feller & Rothstein 2021)
# (see DECISIONS.md D02: augsynth not installable; one function reused for all placebos)
ascm_fit <- function(panel, treated, donors, start, pre_from, end, match_synth = TRUE,
                     lambda_grid = 10^seq(-5, 2, by = 0.5)) {

  # Wide matrices: units x months
  months <- sort(unique(panel$date[panel$date >= pre_from & panel$date <= end]))
  units <- c(treated, donors)
  to_wide <- function(var) {
    m <- panel %>%
      filter(state %in% units, date %in% months) %>%
      select(state, date, value = all_of(var)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = date, values_from = value) %>%
      column_to_rownames("state") %>%
      as.matrix()
    m[units, as.character(months), drop = FALSE]
  }
  y <- to_wide("rate")
  s <- to_wide("synth_rate")
  pre_cols <- which(months < start)

  # SCM weights on pre-period columns, plus ingredients of the ridge correction
  scm_weights <- function(cols) {
    x <- y[, cols, drop = FALSE] / sd(y[, cols])
    if (match_synth) x <- cbind(x, s[, cols, drop = FALSE] / sd(s[, cols]))
    x1 <- x[treated, ]
    x0 <- x[donors, , drop = FALSE]
    n_donor <- length(donors)
    p_mat <- 2 * (x0 %*% t(x0) + 1e-6 * diag(n_donor))
    q_vec <- -2 * as.vector(x0 %*% x1)
    a_mat <- rbind(rep(1, n_donor), diag(n_donor))
    sol <- solve_osqp(p_mat, q_vec, a_mat, c(1, rep(0, n_donor)), c(1, rep(1, n_donor)),
                      osqpSettings(verbose = FALSE, eps_abs = 1e-9, eps_rel = 1e-9,
                                   max_iter = 50000L, polish = TRUE))
    w <- pmax(sol$x, 0)
    w <- w / sum(w)
    x0c <- sweep(x0, 2, colMeans(x0))
    list(w = w, x0c = x0c, imbalance = x1 - as.vector(t(x0) %*% w))
  }
  ridge_gamma <- function(fw, lambda_rel) {
    gram <- fw$x0c %*% t(fw$x0c)
    lambda <- lambda_rel * mean(diag(gram))
    fw$w + as.vector(solve(gram + lambda * diag(length(fw$w)), fw$x0c %*% fw$imbalance))
  }

  # Choose lambda on the last 12 pre-period months (holdout)
  train_cols <- head(pre_cols, -12)
  valid_cols <- tail(pre_cols, 12)
  fw_train <- scm_weights(train_cols)
  valid_rmse <- sapply(lambda_grid, function(l) {
    g <- ridge_gamma(fw_train, l)
    sqrt(mean((y[treated, valid_cols] - as.vector(t(y[donors, valid_cols, drop = FALSE]) %*% g))^2))
  })
  lambda_best <- lambda_grid[which.min(valid_rmse)]

  # Final fit on the full pre-period
  fw <- scm_weights(pre_cols)
  gamma <- ridge_gamma(fw, lambda_best)
  synthetic <- as.vector(t(y[donors, , drop = FALSE]) %*% gamma)
  synthetic_scm <- as.vector(t(y[donors, , drop = FALSE]) %*% fw$w)
  path <- tibble(
    date = months,
    event = (as.integer(format(months, "%Y")) - as.integer(format(start, "%Y"))) * 12 +
      as.integer(format(months, "%m")) - as.integer(format(start, "%m")),
    actual = y[treated, ],
    synthetic = synthetic,
    synthetic_scm = synthetic_scm,
    gap = actual - synthetic
  )
  list(
    treated = treated,
    path = path,
    weights = tibble(state = donors, w_scm = fw$w, w_ascm = gamma),
    lambda = lambda_best,
    pre_rmspe = sqrt(mean(path$gap[path$event < 0]^2))
  )
}

# Effect summary over a set of event months (12-month-ending windows)
ascm_effect <- function(fit, events = fully_post_event) {
  post <- fit$path %>% filter(event %in% events)
  tibble(
    state = fit$treated,
    gap_per100k = mean(post$gap),
    pct = 100 * mean(post$gap) / mean(post$synthetic),
    rmspe_ratio = sqrt(mean(post$gap^2)) / fit$pre_rmspe,
    pre_rmspe = fit$pre_rmspe,
    n_events = nrow(post)
  )
}

# In-space placebos: every donor in turn as the treated unit
ascm_placebos <- function(panel, donors, start, pre_from, end, match_synth = TRUE,
                          events = fully_post_event) {
  map_dfr(donors, function(s) {
    ascm_effect(ascm_fit(panel, s, setdiff(donors, s), start, pre_from, end, match_synth), events)
  })
}

# Two-sided permutation p-value (treated unit counted in the reference set)
perm_p <- function(treated_value, placebo_values) {
  (1 + sum(abs(placebo_values) >= abs(treated_value))) / (1 + length(placebo_values))
}
```

# 01. DATA CLEANING

```{r data_cleaning}
################################################################################
# 01. DATA CLEANING
################################################################################

# Raw CDC VSRR provisional overdose deaths (12-month-ending counts)
raw_vsrr <- read_csv("raw/vsrr_xkb8-kh2a.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
print(nrow(raw_vsrr))

# Keep total deaths and synthetic opioids (T40.4); one row per state-month
vsrr <- raw_vsrr %>%
  rename(
    state = State, year = Year, month_name = Month, indicator = Indicator,
    reported = `Data Value`, predicted = `Predicted Value`, state_name = `State Name`,
    footnote = Footnote
  ) %>%
  filter(indicator %in% c("Number of Drug Overdose Deaths", "Synthetic opioids, excl. methadone (T40.4)")) %>%
  mutate(
    month = match(month_name, month.name),
    date = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year, month)),
    deaths = coalesce(predicted, reported),
    measure = case_when(
      indicator == "Number of Drug Overdose Deaths" ~ "deaths_total",
      indicator == "Synthetic opioids, excl. methadone (T40.4)" ~ "deaths_synth",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!state %in% c("US", "YC", "PR")) %>%
  select(state, state_name, year, date, measure, deaths) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = deaths)

print(nrow(vsrr))
print(max(vsrr$date))

# Latest month with underreporting flag, all states (D06)
print(raw_vsrr %>%
  filter(str_detect(Footnote, "Underreported")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", Year, match(Month, month.name)))) %>%
  summarise(first_flagged = min(date), last_available = max(date)))

# Analysis window: Jan 2015 - Dec 2025 (D06)
vsrr <- vsrr %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2015-01-01"), date <= main_end)
print(nrow(vsrr))

# Census population (July 1), Vintage 2020 for 2015-2019, Vintage 2025 for 2020-2025 (D08)
pop_2010s <- read_csv("raw/NST-EST2020-ALLDATA.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(SUMLEV == "040") %>%
  select(state_name = NAME, POPESTIMATE2015:POPESTIMATE2019)
pop_2020s <- read_csv("raw/NST-EST2025-ALLDATA.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(SUMLEV == "040") %>%
  select(state_name = NAME, POPESTIMATE2020:POPESTIMATE2025)
population <- pop_2010s %>%
  inner_join(pop_2020s, by = "state_name") %>%
  pivot_longer(-state_name, names_to = "year", values_to = "population") %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_remove(year, "POPESTIMATE")))
print(nrow(population))

# Census region (West) for robustness
west_states <- c("AK", "AZ", "CA", "CO", "HI", "ID", "MT", "NV", "NM", "OR", "UT", "WA", "WY")

# Donor exclusions: treated states and states with hard-drug possession-law changes (D12)
excluded_states <- c("OR", "WA", "CA", "CO", "NV")

# Merge, compute rates per 100,000 (12-month-ending)
df_clean <- vsrr %>%
  left_join(population, by = c("state_name", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    rate = deaths_total / population * 1e5,
    synth_rate = deaths_synth / population * 1e5,
    west = state %in% west_states,
    excluded = state %in% excluded_states
  )
print(sum(is.na(df_clean$population)))
print(n_distinct(df_clean$state))

# Synthetic-opioid completeness, 2019-2025 and 2015-2022 windows (D13)
synth_complete <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    synth_complete_main = all(!is.na(synth_rate[date >= main_pre_from])),
    synth_complete_decrim = all(!is.na(synth_rate[date <= as.Date("2022-12-01")]))
  )
print(synth_complete %>% filter(!synth_complete_main | !synth_complete_decrim), n = 60)

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  left_join(synth_complete, by = "state")

# Oregon CJC PCS-only arrests, quarterly (D04)
or_arrests_cjc <- read_csv("raw/cjc_or_pcs_only_arrests_quarterly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(quarter_start = as.Date(quarter_start))
print(or_arrests_cjc, n = 40)

# FBI CDE drug-abuse-violation arrests, monthly (D05), whichever files were obtained
fbi_files <- list.files("raw", pattern = "^fbi_arrest_.*_18\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
print(fbi_files)
fbi_arrests <- map_dfr(fbi_files, function(f) {
  js <- fromJSON(f)
  if (is.null(js$actuals)) return(tibble())
  key <- names(js$actuals)[str_detect(names(js$actuals), "Arrests") & !str_detect(names(js$actuals), "United States")]
  tibble(
    state = str_extract(basename(f), "(?<=fbi_arrest_)[A-Z]{2}"),
    month_key = names(js$actuals[[key]]),
    arrests = unlist(js$actuals[[key]]),
    rate_per100k = unlist(js$rates[[key]][names(js$actuals[[key]])]),
    us_rate_per100k = unlist(js$rates[["United States Arrests"]][names(js$actuals[[key]])])
  )
})
if (nrow(fbi_arrests) > 0) {
  fbi_arrests <- fbi_arrests %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(paste0(str_sub(month_key, 4, 7), "-", str_sub(month_key, 1, 2), "-01"))) %>%
    select(state, date, arrests, rate_per100k, us_rate_per100k) %>%
    arrange(state, date)
} else {
  fbi_arrests <- tibble(note = "FBI CDE arrests not obtained; see DECISIONS.md D05")
}
print(fbi_arrests)

# Save clean data
write_xlsx(
  list(panel = df_clean, or_arrests_cjc = or_arrests_cjc, fbi_arrests = fbi_arrests),
  "clean_data.xlsx"
)
```

# G1. STEP 0 GATE: FIRST STAGE (ARRESTS)

## G1.1 Data preparation

```{r g1_prep}
################################################################################
# G1.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

g1_cjc <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "or_arrests_cjc") %>%
  mutate(
    quarter_start = as.Date(quarter_start),
    period = case_when(
      quarter_start < as.Date("2021-01-01") ~ "1 pre-M110 (2018Q1-2020Q4)",
      quarter_start >= as.Date("2021-04-01") & quarter_start < as.Date("2024-07-01") ~ "2 M110 (2021Q2-2024Q2)",
      quarter_start >= as.Date("2024-10-01") ~ "3 HB 4002 (2024Q4-2025Q4)",
      TRUE ~ "transition quarter"
    )
  )
print(nrow(g1_cjc))

g1_fbi <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "fbi_arrests")
print(nrow(g1_fbi))
```

## G1.2 Analysis

```{r g1_analysis}
################################################################################
# G1.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Oregon PCS-only arrests per quarter, by period
g1_cjc_summary <- g1_cjc %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(mean_per_quarter = mean(pcs_only_arrests), n_quarters = n())
print(g1_cjc_summary)

# Ratio HB 4002 / M110 and HB 4002 / pre-M110
g1_ratio_vs_m110 <- g1_cjc_summary$mean_per_quarter[3] / g1_cjc_summary$mean_per_quarter[2]
g1_ratio_vs_pre <- g1_cjc_summary$mean_per_quarter[3] / g1_cjc_summary$mean_per_quarter[1]
print(g1_ratio_vs_m110)
print(g1_ratio_vs_pre)

# FBI drug-abuse-violation arrests (possession + sale), 12 months before vs after each date
if ("arrests" %in% names(g1_fbi)) {
  g1_fbi_summary <- g1_fbi %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      policy_date = if_else(state == "OR", or_recrim_date, wa_recrim_date),
      window = case_when(
        date >= policy_date - months(12) & date < policy_date ~ "12 m before",
        date >= policy_date & date < policy_date + months(12) ~ "12 m after",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(window)) %>%
    group_by(state, window) %>%
    summarise(mean_monthly_arrests = mean(arrests), mean_rate = mean(rate_per100k),
              mean_us_rate = mean(us_rate_per100k), .groups = "drop")
  print(g1_fbi_summary)
} else {
  g1_fbi_summary <- tibble()
  print("FBI arrests not obtained (rate limit); see DECISIONS.md D05")
}
```

# G2. STEP 0 GATE: POWER

## G2.1 Data preparation

```{r g2_prep}
################################################################################
# G2.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

g2_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  filter(date >= main_pre_from, date <= main_end)
g2_donors <- g2_df %>% filter(!excluded, synth_complete_main) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
print(length(g2_donors))
```

## G2.2 Analysis

```{r g2_power}
################################################################################
# G2.2 Analysis: placebo distribution at fake start dates in the pre-period (D17)
################################################################################

g2_fake_dates <- as.Date(c("2021-09-01", "2022-01-01", "2022-09-01", "2023-01-01"))
g2_power <- map_dfr(g2_fake_dates, function(d) {
  ascm_placebos(g2_df, c("OR", g2_donors), d, main_pre_from, d + months(15), match_synth = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(fake_start = d)
})
print(g2_power %>% group_by(fake_start) %>% summarise(q95_abs_pct = quantile(abs(pct), 0.95), n = n()))

# Minimum detectable effect: 95th percentile of |placebo % effect|
g2_mde <- quantile(abs(g2_power$pct), 0.95)
print(g2_mde)
print(g2_mde > 20)

# Sensitivity of the gate: total-deaths-only matching, all non-excluded donors
g2_donors_all_power <- g2_df %>% filter(!excluded) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
g2_power_total_only <- map_dfr(g2_fake_dates, function(d) {
  ascm_placebos(g2_df, c("OR", g2_donors_all_power), d, main_pre_from, d + months(15), match_synth = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(fake_start = d)
})
g2_mde_total_only <- quantile(abs(g2_power_total_only$pct), 0.95)
print(g2_mde_total_only)

# Sensitivity of the gate: Washington design (event 11-15), main matching
g2_power_wa <- map_dfr(as.Date(c("2021-09-01", "2022-01-01")), function(d) {
  ascm_placebos(g2_df, c("WA", g2_donors), d, main_pre_from, d + months(15), match_synth = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(fake_start = d)
})
print(quantile(abs(g2_power_wa$pct), 0.95))

# Gate decision (pre-specified main specification)
gate_power_passed <- g2_mde <= 20
print(gate_power_passed)
```

# H1. OREGON: RECRIMINALIZATION (SEPT 2024) (EXPLORATORY: POWER GATE FAILED)

## H1.1 Data preparation

```{r h1_prep}
################################################################################
# H1.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h1_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  filter(date >= main_pre_from, date <= main_end)

# Main donor pool: not excluded, complete synthetic-opioid series (D12, D13)
h1_donors <- h1_df %>% filter(!excluded, synth_complete_main) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
h1_donors_all <- h1_df %>% filter(!excluded) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
h1_donors_west <- h1_df %>% filter(!excluded, west) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
print(length(h1_donors))
print(h1_donors)
print(setdiff(h1_donors_all, h1_donors))
print(h1_donors_west)
print(nrow(h1_df))
```

## H1.2 Analysis

```{r h1_analysis}
################################################################################
# H1.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Main ASCM: match on total and synthetic-opioid trajectories
h1_fit <- ascm_fit(h1_df, "OR", h1_donors, or_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = TRUE)
print(h1_fit$lambda)
print(h1_fit$pre_rmspe)
print(h1_fit$weights %>% filter(w_scm > 0.01) %>% arrange(desc(w_scm)))
print(h1_fit$path %>% filter(event >= -3), n = 30)

# Primary estimate (event months 11-15, Aug-Dec 2025)
h1_effect <- ascm_effect(h1_fit)
print(h1_effect)

# Calendar 2025 window (event 15) and excess deaths in 2025
h1_effect_2025 <- ascm_effect(h1_fit, events = 15)
h1_pop_2025 <- h1_df %>% filter(state == "OR", date == main_end) %>% pull(population)
print(h1_effect_2025)
print(h1_effect_2025$gap_per100k * h1_pop_2025 / 1e5)

# In-space placebos and permutation p-value
h1_placebos <- ascm_placebos(h1_df, h1_donors, or_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = TRUE)
print(h1_placebos %>% arrange(desc(abs(pct))), n = 60)
h1_p_pct <- perm_p(h1_effect$pct, h1_placebos$pct)
h1_p_ratio <- (1 + sum(h1_placebos$rmspe_ratio >= h1_effect$rmspe_ratio)) / (1 + nrow(h1_placebos))
print(h1_p_pct)
print(h1_p_ratio)
```

## H1.3 Robustness

```{r h1_robustness}
################################################################################
# H1.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# In-time placebos: fake starts Sept 2022 and Jan 2023
h1_intime_2022 <- ascm_effect(ascm_fit(h1_df, "OR", h1_donors, as.Date("2022-09-01"), main_pre_from, as.Date("2023-12-01"), match_synth = TRUE))
h1_intime_2023 <- ascm_effect(ascm_fit(h1_df, "OR", h1_donors, as.Date("2023-01-01"), main_pre_from, as.Date("2024-04-01"), match_synth = TRUE))
print(h1_intime_2022)
print(h1_intime_2023)

# Match on total deaths only, all non-excluded donors
h1_fit_total_only <- ascm_fit(h1_df, "OR", h1_donors_all, or_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = FALSE)
h1_effect_total_only <- ascm_effect(h1_fit_total_only)
h1_placebos_total_only <- ascm_placebos(h1_df, h1_donors_all, or_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = FALSE)
print(h1_effect_total_only)
print(perm_p(h1_effect_total_only$pct, h1_placebos_total_only$pct))

# Western donors only (total deaths only, too few with complete T40.4)
h1_fit_west <- ascm_fit(h1_df, "OR", h1_donors_west, or_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = FALSE)
h1_effect_west <- ascm_effect(h1_fit_west)
print(h1_fit_west$weights %>% arrange(desc(w_scm)))
print(h1_effect_west)

# Leave-one-donor-out (donors with SCM weight > 1%)
h1_loo_donors <- h1_fit$weights %>% filter(w_scm > 0.01) %>% pull(state)
h1_loo <- map_dfr(h1_loo_donors, function(d) {
  ascm_effect(ascm_fit(h1_df, "OR", setdiff(h1_donors, d), or_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(dropped = d)
})
print(h1_loo)

# Synthetic-opioid deaths as the outcome (secondary)
h1_df_synth_outcome <- h1_df %>% mutate(rate = synth_rate)
h1_fit_synth_outcome <- ascm_fit(h1_df_synth_outcome, "OR", h1_donors, or_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = FALSE)
print(ascm_effect(h1_fit_synth_outcome))

# DiD cross-check: OR vs Western donors, log rate, partially-post windows dropped (D20)
h1_did_df <- h1_df %>%
  filter(state %in% c("OR", h1_donors_west)) %>%
  mutate(
    event = (as.integer(format(date, "%Y")) - 2024) * 12 + as.integer(format(date, "%m")) - 9,
    treat_post = as.integer(state == "OR" & event >= 11)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(event >= 0 & event <= 10))
h1_did <- feols(
  log(rate) ~ treat_post | state + date,
  data = h1_did_df,
  cluster = ~state
)
print(summary(h1_did))
print(coeftable(h1_did)["treat_post", ])
print(confint(h1_did)["treat_post", ])
print(100 * (exp(coef(h1_did)["treat_post"]) - 1))
```

# H2. WASHINGTON: RECRIMINALIZATION (JULY 2023) (EXPLORATORY: POWER GATE FAILED)

## H2.1 Data preparation

```{r h2_prep}
################################################################################
# H2.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h2_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  filter(date >= main_pre_from, date <= main_end)

h2_donors <- h2_df %>% filter(!excluded, synth_complete_main) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
h2_donors_all <- h2_df %>% filter(!excluded) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
h2_donors_west <- h2_df %>% filter(!excluded, west) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
print(length(h2_donors))
print(nrow(h2_df))
```

## H2.2 Analysis

```{r h2_analysis}
################################################################################
# H2.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Main ASCM
h2_fit <- ascm_fit(h2_df, "WA", h2_donors, wa_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = TRUE)
print(h2_fit$lambda)
print(h2_fit$pre_rmspe)
print(h2_fit$weights %>% filter(w_scm > 0.01) %>% arrange(desc(w_scm)))

# Aligned estimate (event 11-15, June-Oct 2024) and all fully-post windows (event 11-29)
h2_effect <- ascm_effect(h2_fit)
h2_effect_all_post <- ascm_effect(h2_fit, events = 11:29)
print(h2_effect)
print(h2_effect_all_post)

# Calendar 2024 (event 17) and 2025 (event 29) windows, excess deaths
h2_effect_2024 <- ascm_effect(h2_fit, events = 17)
h2_effect_2025 <- ascm_effect(h2_fit, events = 29)
h2_pop <- h2_df %>% filter(state == "WA", date %in% as.Date(c("2024-12-01", "2025-12-01"))) %>% pull(population)
print(h2_effect_2024)
print(h2_effect_2025)
print(c(h2_effect_2024$gap_per100k, h2_effect_2025$gap_per100k) * h2_pop / 1e5)

# In-space placebos
h2_placebos <- ascm_placebos(h2_df, h2_donors, wa_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = TRUE)
h2_placebos_all_post <- ascm_placebos(h2_df, h2_donors, wa_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = TRUE, events = 11:29)
print(perm_p(h2_effect$pct, h2_placebos$pct))
print(perm_p(h2_effect_all_post$pct, h2_placebos_all_post$pct))
print((1 + sum(h2_placebos$rmspe_ratio >= h2_effect$rmspe_ratio)) / (1 + nrow(h2_placebos)))
```

## H2.3 Robustness

```{r h2_robustness}
################################################################################
# H2.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# In-time placebo: fake start Jan 2022 (window ends Apr 2023)
print(ascm_effect(ascm_fit(h2_df, "WA", h2_donors, as.Date("2022-01-01"), main_pre_from, as.Date("2023-04-01"), match_synth = TRUE)))

# Total deaths only, all non-excluded donors
h2_effect_total_only <- ascm_effect(ascm_fit(h2_df, "WA", h2_donors_all, wa_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = FALSE))
print(h2_effect_total_only)

# Western donors only
h2_effect_west <- ascm_effect(ascm_fit(h2_df, "WA", h2_donors_west, wa_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = FALSE))
print(h2_effect_west)

# Leave-one-donor-out
h2_loo_donors <- h2_fit$weights %>% filter(w_scm > 0.01) %>% pull(state)
h2_loo <- map_dfr(h2_loo_donors, function(d) {
  ascm_effect(ascm_fit(h2_df, "WA", setdiff(h2_donors, d), wa_recrim_date, main_pre_from, main_end, match_synth = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(dropped = d)
})
print(h2_loo)

# DiD cross-check vs Western donors
h2_did_df <- h2_df %>%
  filter(state %in% c("WA", h2_donors_west)) %>%
  mutate(
    event = (as.integer(format(date, "%Y")) - 2023) * 12 + as.integer(format(date, "%m")) - 7,
    treat_post = as.integer(state == "WA" & event >= 11)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(event >= 0 & event <= 10))
h2_did <- feols(
  log(rate) ~ treat_post | state + date,
  data = h2_did_df,
  cluster = ~state
)
print(summary(h2_did))
print(coeftable(h2_did)["treat_post", ])
print(confint(h2_did)["treat_post", ])
print(100 * (exp(coef(h2_did)["treat_post"]) - 1))
```

# H3. STACKED OR + WA (EXPLORATORY: POWER GATE FAILED)

```{r h3_stacked}
################################################################################
# H3. Stacked estimate (event months 11-15, D19)
################################################################################

# Average of the two % effects
h3_effect <- mean(c(h1_effect$pct, h2_effect$pct))
print(h3_effect)

# Placebo: each donor's average across both designs
h3_placebos <- h1_placebos %>%
  select(state, pct_or = pct) %>%
  inner_join(h2_placebos %>% select(state, pct_wa = pct), by = "state") %>%
  mutate(pct = (pct_or + pct_wa) / 2)
print(nrow(h3_placebos))
h3_p <- perm_p(h3_effect, h3_placebos$pct)
print(h3_p)

# Stacked gap path by event time
h3_path <- bind_rows(
  h1_fit$path %>% mutate(state = "OR"),
  h2_fit$path %>% mutate(state = "WA")
) %>%
  mutate(pct_gap = 100 * gap / synthetic) %>%
  group_by(event) %>%
  summarise(mean_pct_gap = mean(pct_gap), n_states = n()) %>%
  filter(n_states == 2)
print(h3_path %>% filter(event >= -6), n = 40)
```

# S1. SECONDARY: DECRIMINALIZATION REPLICATION (FEB 2021) (EXPLORATORY)

## S1.1 Data preparation

```{r s1_prep}
################################################################################
# S1.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

s1_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2015-01-01"), date <= as.Date("2023-12-01"))

s1_donors <- s1_df %>% filter(!excluded, synth_complete_decrim) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
s1_donors_all <- s1_df %>% filter(!excluded) %>% distinct(state) %>% pull(state)
print(length(s1_donors))
print(length(s1_donors_all))
```

## S1.2 Analysis

```{r s1_analysis}
################################################################################
# S1.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Oregon M110, matched on total + synthetic opioids (end Dec 2022)
s1_fit_or <- ascm_fit(s1_df, "OR", s1_donors, decrim_date, as.Date("2015-01-01"), as.Date("2022-12-01"), match_synth = TRUE)
s1_effect_or <- ascm_effect(s1_fit_or, events = 11:22)
s1_placebos_or <- ascm_placebos(s1_df, s1_donors, decrim_date, as.Date("2015-01-01"), as.Date("2022-12-01"), match_synth = TRUE, events = 11:22)
print(s1_effect_or)
print(perm_p(s1_effect_or$pct, s1_placebos_or$pct))

# Oregon M110, matched on total only (crude analogue)
s1_fit_or_total <- ascm_fit(s1_df, "OR", s1_donors_all, decrim_date, as.Date("2015-01-01"), as.Date("2022-12-01"), match_synth = FALSE)
s1_effect_or_total <- ascm_effect(s1_fit_or_total, events = 11:22)
s1_placebos_or_total <- ascm_placebos(s1_df, s1_donors_all, decrim_date, as.Date("2015-01-01"), as.Date("2022-12-01"), match_synth = FALSE, events = 11:22)
print(s1_effect_or_total)
print(perm_p(s1_effect_or_total$pct, s1_placebos_or_total$pct))

# Washington Blake, matched on total + synthetic opioids
s1_fit_wa <- ascm_fit(s1_df, "WA", s1_donors, decrim_date, as.Date("2015-01-01"), as.Date("2022-12-01"), match_synth = TRUE)
s1_effect_wa <- ascm_effect(s1_fit_wa, events = 11:22)
s1_placebos_wa <- ascm_placebos(s1_df, s1_donors, decrim_date, as.Date("2015-01-01"), as.Date("2022-12-01"), match_synth = TRUE, events = 11:22)
print(s1_effect_wa)
print(perm_p(s1_effect_wa$pct, s1_placebos_wa$pct))

# Washington Blake, total only
s1_fit_wa_total <- ascm_fit(s1_df, "WA", s1_donors_all, decrim_date, as.Date("2015-01-01"), as.Date("2022-12-01"), match_synth = FALSE)
s1_effect_wa_total <- ascm_effect(s1_fit_wa_total, events = 11:22)
print(s1_effect_wa_total)

# Excess deaths in calendar 2022 window (event 22), OR and WA, main and total-only
s1_pop_2022 <- s1_df %>% filter(date == as.Date("2022-12-01"), state %in% c("OR", "WA")) %>% select(state, population)
print(s1_pop_2022)
s1_excess_2022 <- tibble(
  state = c("OR", "OR", "WA", "WA"),
  spec = c("total+synth", "total only", "total+synth", "total only"),
  gap_per100k_2022 = c(
    ascm_effect(s1_fit_or, events = 22)$gap_per100k,
    ascm_effect(s1_fit_or_total, events = 22)$gap_per100k,
    ascm_effect(s1_fit_wa, events = 22)$gap_per100k,
    ascm_effect(s1_fit_wa_total, events = 22)$gap_per100k
  )
) %>%
  left_join(s1_pop_2022, by = "state") %>%
  mutate(excess_deaths_2022 = gap_per100k_2022 * population / 1e5)
print(s1_excess_2022)

# Monthly-rate equivalent of the first-year gap (compare Joshi et al.: per 100k per month)
print(ascm_effect(s1_fit_or, events = 12)$gap_per100k / 12)
print(ascm_effect(s1_fit_wa, events = 12)$gap_per100k / 12)
```

print(fig3_placebo)
